sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash (Ox Alpha): Specs, Price & API - glm-ai.chat
sources.snippet: A source-checked guide to GLM-5.3-Flash, formerly Ox Alpha, covering its multimodal architecture, 1M context, API prices, Coding Plan, open weights and vendor-reported benchmarks. Ox Alpha was the anonymous preview name for GLM-5.3-Flash, not a separate GLM model.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
